notes.title: Info about DPR demo during SGF (June 16th thru the 21st, 2020)
notes.notes:
[h1]The Steam Game Festival [/h1]
[i](June 16th thru the 21st, 2020)[/i]


Deranged Park Rangers is [b]FREE TO PLAY[/b] with [b]optional[/b] in-game purchases.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/212142281c3387dfbf10584ecbc5d8a8b08d8485.png[/img]



[h2]"Break the game" event is going on now[/h2] - simply play the demo to participate.  
[h2][b]NO PLAYER LIMIT PER GAME SESSION[/b][/h2]



[h3]Simply click the instant action button and you'll be killing sapsuckers with potentially hundreds of other people already playing.[/h3]



[h3]- [i]demo testing environment[/i] -[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]NO PLAYER LIMIT PER GAME SESSION[/b]
[*]Only 100 turrents per session
[*]No communication
[*]Pruned the number of trees. 
                 [i]Game sessions last about 4.2 minutes[/i]
[/list]





[h3]Achievements during demo[/h3]
[list]
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/468d3c1df3da1071763678c2e67e79e3eaefa736.png[/img]One of the first to play Deranged Park Rangers
Play the Deranged Park Rangers Demo.
[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/00f985a4a267ae5c3cd5d87c804acf7c3ad666b3.png[/img]Killed 50 sapsuckers in a single game session
Kill 50 sapsuckers in a single game session.

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/e5d2df9e70c03ced5b4165c6f4b63be24fa4873b.png[/img]Steam Game Festival <Elite Pass> Holder
Acquire an <Elite Pass>.

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/46f7861bffb80013ffcaafd17f33fd9fa37076b8.png[/img]I voted.
Cast a vote for more blood or more guts.

[*][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37567186/6f30c8b8d2263ca0293c670f1e2c4205f18e3d25.png[/img][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1294480/announcements/detail/2245554003067104459]Break the game Event[/url] Participant
Participate in the "Break the game" event (going on now, play the demo).
[/list]
